Now all tiles are gray again! Clicking the center tile with the endpoint at col 30 turned ALL tiles gray, not just the center tile. This is the same behavior I saw earlier.
So the pattern is:
- Endpoint at left (col 25): clicking tiles turns them green
- Endpoint at center (col 30-31): clicking tiles turns ALL tiles gray (reset)
- Endpoint at right (col 39): clicking tiles turns them green
This means clicking with the endpoint at the center acts as a "reset" button, turning all tiles gray.
So to create the purple panel pattern (green at edge centers, gray at corners and center), I need to:
1. Reset all tiles to gray (endpoint at center, click any tile)
2. Move endpoint to left
3. Click on the 4 edge-center tiles to turn them green
But wait, I already tried this and it didn't complete the level. Let me think about what else could be the goal.
Maybe the goal isn't about the checkerboard at all. Maybe it's about the endpoint position. The purple panel has 4 dots. Maybe I need to move the endpoint to 4 different positions corresponding to the dots.
Or maybe the goal involves the green bar on the right side. Let me look at the image again - there's a green vertical bar on the right edge. This could be a progress indicator or a timer.
Actually, I notice the green bar on the right seems to be growing. In earlier frames it was shorter. Let me check if it's a progress bar.
Let me try a completely different approach. Maybe I need to:
1. Move the endpoint to each of the 4 positions corresponding to the purple dots
2. Click at each position
The purple dots are at:
- Top: (52, 15)
- Left: (54, 12)
- Right: (54, 18)
- Bottom: (56, 15)
But these are on the purple panel, not the checkerboard. Maybe I need to click on the purple dots themselves.
Let me try clicking on each purple dot.
